_meta.name: Lighthouse Lightweight Framework (synthetic)
_meta.note: Fictional, minimal framework fixture. Not KenAddme content -- DEC03 licensing is unresolved, so no real institutional framework ships in this platform yet (REQ-014).

gates.name: Intake
gates.description: Confirm this small piece of work has a named owner and a clear enough purpose before anyone spends real time on it.

rules.guidance: Write a short note naming who owns this item and why it's being done. One or two sentences is enough for lightweight work.
rules.evidence_example: A short intake note or a linked ticket stating the owner and purpose.

gates.name: Release
gates.description: Check the work is finished and that there's a plan for when this record itself can eventually be disposed of.

rules.guidance: Record a disposal date for this evidence so it isn't kept indefinitely once it's no longer needed.
rules.evidence_example: A checklist entry naming the agreed disposal date.
